dz: 罗马将领日耳曼尼库斯死在安提俄克附近. 他确信,他死后结束的神秘疾病是叙利亚州长克奈乌斯·卡尔普尔尼乌斯·皮索(Gnaeus Calpurnius Piso)下毒的结果,他下令离开该省.
de: The Roman general Germanicus dies near Antioch. He was convinced that the mysterious illness that ended in his death was a result of poisoning by the Syrian governor Gnaeus Calpurnius Piso, whom he had ordered to leave the province.
